records.source: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
records.translation: Maaaring may lamang hibla o Halo-halong Binhi.

records.source: Ugly weeds. Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
records.translation: Mga pangit na damo. Maaaring may lamang hibla o Halo-halong Binhi.

records.source: One of the most widely cultivated grains. Makes a great flour for breads and cakes.
records.translation: Isa sa pinakamalawak na itinatanim na butil. Nagiging mahusay na harina para sa tinapay at keyk.

records.source: A common cooking ingredient made from crushed wheat seeds.
records.translation: Karaniwang sangkap sa pagluluto na gawa sa dinurog na mga butil ng trigo.

records.source: Plant these in the summer or fall. Takes 4 days to mature. Harvest with the scythe.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tag-init o taglagas. Tumatagal ng 4 na araw upang mahinog. Anihin gamit ang Karit.

records.source: A unique recipe from Linus that gives you a chance to catch two fish at once.
records.translation: Natatanging resipe ni Linus na nagbibigay ng tsansang makahuli ng dalawang isda nang sabay.

records.englishResidueReason: Ligaw na Horseradish is the established locale item name used in existing translated track text.

records.source: A spicy root found in the spring.
records.translation: Maanghang na ugat na matatagpuan sa tagsibol.

records.englishResidueReason: Plum is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this fruit and is used consistently in existing recipe text.

records.source: Tart and juicy with a pungent aroma.
records.translation: Maasim, makatas, at matapang ang halimuyak.

records.source: A gift that shows you want to stop dating someone.
records.translation: Regalong nagpapakitang nais mong tapusin ang pakikipagrelasyon sa isang tao.

records.englishResidueReason: Cranberry is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this specific fruit.

records.source: An assortment of wild winter seeds.
records.translation: Sari-saring ligaw na binhi mula sa taglamig.

records.source: A sturdy, yet flexible plant material with a wide variety of uses.
records.translation: Matibay ngunit nababaluktot na materyal mula sa halaman na napakaraming gamit.
Pinananatili sa loob ang damo at mga hayop!

records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to decorate your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o palamutian ang iyong mga sahig.

records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o pagandahin ang iyong mga sahig.

records.preserveReason: Woodskip is the fictional fish name used consistently in existing Filipino fish-program text.

records.source: A very sensitive fish that can only live in pools deep in the forest.
records.translation: Napakasensitibong isda na sa malalalim na lawa sa kagubatan lamang nabubuhay.
